title: Awards Gallery Timeline
description: "Our Journey" vertical timeline of years, titles and descriptions.

default.title: The Beginning
default.text: A family of master engravers starts a small workshop in Metro Manila, crafting medals and plaques entirely by hand.

default.title: Growing Reputation
default.text: Word spreads. Schools, government institutions, and corporations begin seeking our craftsmanship for their most prestigious events.

default.title: Second Generation
default.text: The founder's children join the business, introducing modern techniques while preserving the handcrafted soul of every piece.

default.title: Going Corporate
default.text: We expand into large-scale corporate recognition programs, serving some of the Philippines' biggest companies nationwide.

default.title: Third Generation
default.text: Laser engraving, UV printing, and CNC cutting are integrated — without compromising the artisan identity of Awards Gallery.

default.title: Awards Gallery PH
default.text: Over 70 years on, we remain a family business. Every award we make still carries three generations of pride.
